toegepas.voor: kan oor en oor ná mekaar sing
toegepas.na: kan oor en oor beurtelings sing
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Beurtelings' says plainly that leader and group take turns; 'ná mekaar' reads wooden here.
toegepas.fout: 'oor en oor ná mekaar sing' is a loose way to say that a leader and a group alternate
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Beurtelings' is the exact Afrikaans word for leader and group taking turns, keeps the same people and action, and saves a word in a study text at its ceiling.

laat_vaar.voor: Hulle volg dikwels ook sulke patrone.
laat_vaar.na: Hulle volg ook dikwels sulke patrone.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Ook dikwels' is the natural Afrikaans order of these two adverbs.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Both adverb orders are natural Afrikaans here, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Net so' can read as 'just like that'; 'op dieselfde manier' is clearer for a Grade 6 learner.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Net so' is plain, natural Afrikaans for 'in the same way', and the proposal adds two words to a study text already at its word ceiling.

na_skrywer.voor: twee stemme of groepe sing tegelyk verskillende note wat by mekaar pas
na_skrywer.na: wanneer twee stemme of groepe tegelyk verskillende note sing wat by mekaar pas
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The definition is a bare main clause; a 'wanneer' clause matches how the other glossary definitions are built.
na_skrywer.fout: the glossary definition is a bare main clause, unlike the 'wanneer' definitions beside it
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition whose term is shared with other lessons, so only the writer may change it, and for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Speel jy 'n ander se seremonie na, doen dit
laat_vaar_vorige.na: As jy iemand anders se seremonie naspeel, doen dit
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The inverted conditional is formal for Grade 6; 'As jy ... naspeel' is clearer and 'iemand anders se' reads more naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The inverted conditional is ordinary natural Afrikaans, and 'iemand anders se' narrows 'n ander se', which after the previous sentence can also mean another group's ceremony.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Here 'na' means 'after', which takes the accent, as the study text already writes 'ná mekaar'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The opeenvolging entry is carried word for word from earlier signed-off lessons and may not be reworded here, and the acute on 'ná' is optional under the AWS anyway.
